violation_type.title: Care Requirements 5 or More Hours - Provide Indoor and Outdoor Active Play (26 TAC §744.2002(3))
violation_type.short_title: Care Requirements 5 or More Hours - Provide Indoor and Outdoor Active Play
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation is offering summer care from 9am-3pm and does not have an outdoor area.

finding_variants.text: The operation is offering summer care from 9am-3pm and does not have an outdoor area.
The operation has been operating as early as 8:46am and as late as 4:02pm according to sign in documentation when their summer hours are from 10am until 2:59pm.
The operation is offering summer care from 9am-3pm and the operations plan for summer use is between 10am-2:59am.
